about.archiveSectionBody: Every photograph is catalogued with a title, category, event name and date. The collection is organised into four categories — Events, Photoshoots, Red Carpet and Editorial — and can also be browsed by year. New material is added by the archive curators; high-resolution originals are held in secure cloud storage separately from this website.
